name: jr-todo
description: /jrtodo <task>: capture a task instantly, with no model call, to TODO.md, Todoist, Linear, Notion, a GitHub issue, Things, Apple Reminders, or your own command.

target.title: Where tasks go
target.description: markdown (a TODO.md file), todoist, linear, notion, github (an issue in the current repo), things, reminders (Apple Reminders) or custom (your own command).

file.title: Markdown file
file.description: For the markdown target: a path, absolute or relative to the project root. Empty: TODO.md at the project root.

linearKey.title: Linear API key
linearKey.description: Linear → Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys (starts with lin_api_).

linearTeamId.title: Linear team id
linearTeamId.description: The id of the team new issues go to.

notionToken.title: Notion token
notionToken.description: An internal integration token, with the database shared to the integration.

notionDatabaseId.title: Notion database id
notionDatabaseId.description: The database new tasks are added to.

notionTitleProperty.title: Notion title property
notionTitleProperty.description: The name of the database's title column.

command.title: Custom command
command.description: For the custom target: a shell command with {task} where the task goes, passed as one quoted argument. Example: my-tasks add {task}
